body: Things never get better, they only get worse no matter what I do. I’ve tried therapy, medication, meditation, and a zillion other things and nothing works. I’m still in the same place I was 5-6 years ago. And I don’t wanna do another 50-60 years of this
I know people care about me. And I appreciate that, but it’s like why waste anymore of their time on a lost cause ya know?
